# NEXORA Salon OS

> NEXORA Salon OS helps salon, spa and beauty businesses explore customisable website templates and manage their online presence.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://nexorasalon.online/): Explore NEXORA and all 16 public salon website templates.
- [SalonOS platform](https://nexorasalon.online/salon-os): Overview of NEXORA SalonOS salon management software.
- [Pricing & plans](https://nexorasalon.online/pricing): Compare NEXORA SalonOS plans and feature coverage.
- [Salon onboarding](https://nexorasalon.online/salon-onboarding): Choose a template, add branding and publish your salon website.
- [Salon growth](https://nexorasalon.online/salon-growth): Organise customer records, booking workflows, recall and reporting.
- [Growth Partner rewards](https://nexorasalon.online/growth-partner-rewards): Reward milestones and programme terms.
- [Partner Rewards & Recognition](https://nexorasalon.online/partner-rewards): Partner rewards and Top Salon Jaipur Awards.
- [Privacy notice](https://nexorasalon.online/privacy): Privacy notice for demo requests.
- [Salon website templates](https://nexorasalon.online/#nexora-template-library): Compare example designs and choose a starting point.

## Notes
- Template service categories are examples. Owners customise business information, services, prices and imagery before publishing.
- Published salon sites remain available through their existing `/<slug>` and `/?site=<slug>` routes.
- Sign-in, customer app, staff, owner workspace and admin pages are private and marked non-indexable (`noindex`).
